title: Power bounds for the odd-level tail
statement: If $k$ is an odd natural number, then $(2/\pi)^{3/2}(k+2)^{-1/2}\leq T(k)\leq (2/\pi)^{3/2}\bigl(k^{-1/2}+(1/3)k^{-3/2}\bigr)$, where $T(k)$ is the limiting majority Fourier weight above $k$.
